diff --git a/fastapi/dependencies/models.py b/fastapi/dependencies/models.py
index fbb666a7..d8b09a05 100644
--- a/fastapi/dependencies/models.py
+++ b/fastapi/dependencies/models.py
@@ -15,6 +15,14 @@ else:  # pragma: no cover
     from asyncio import iscoroutinefunction
 
 
+def _unwrap_call(call: Optional[Callable[..., Any]]) -> Optional[Callable[..., Any]]:
+    # Follow __wrapped__ (e.g. functools.cache / lru_cache wrappers) to the
+    # original callable so that coroutine and generator detection works.
+    if call is None:
+        return None
+    return inspect.unwrap(call)
+
+
 @dataclass
 class SecurityRequirement:
     security_scheme: SecurityBase
@@ -77,25 +85,28 @@ class Dependant:
 
     @cached_property
     def is_gen_callable(self) -> bool:
-        if inspect.isgeneratorfunction(self.call):
+        call = _unwrap_call(self.call)
+        if inspect.isgeneratorfunction(call):
             return True
-        dunder_call = getattr(self.call, "__call__", None)  # noqa: B004
+        dunder_call = getattr(call, "__call__", None)  # noqa: B004
         return inspect.isgeneratorfunction(dunder_call)
 
     @cached_property
     def is_async_gen_callable(self) -> bool:
-        if inspect.isasyncgenfunction(self.call):
+        call = _unwrap_call(self.call)
+        if inspect.isasyncgenfunction(call):
             return True
-        dunder_call = getattr(self.call, "__call__", None)  # noqa: B004
+        dunder_call = getattr(call, "__call__", None)  # noqa: B004
         return inspect.isasyncgenfunction(dunder_call)
 
     @cached_property
     def is_coroutine_callable(self) -> bool:
-        if inspect.isroutine(self.call):
-            return iscoroutinefunction(self.call)
-        if inspect.isclass(self.call):
+        call = _unwrap_call(self.call)
+        if inspect.isroutine(call):
+            return iscoroutinefunction(call)
+        if inspect.isclass(call):
             return False
-        dunder_call = getattr(self.call, "__call__", None)  # noqa: B004
+        dunder_call = getattr(call, "__call__", None)  # noqa: B004
         return iscoroutinefunction(dunder_call)
 
     @cached_property
